units.time: simulated days and actual full 8-hour food workdays

description: Independent Agriculture Balance v0.1 analytical candidate. Does not replace sim.js or change existing gameplay until explicitly integrated and tested.

river.distanceOrigin: river bank (map centerline distance minus half-width of 1.6 cells, clamped to zero)
river.meaning: seasonal moisture contribution potential, not fixed soil moisture

land.harvestMechanic: actual yield is limited by accumulated unharvested crop stock and worker capacity; do not create food by formula alone

worker.learningRule: S(n) = 1 - (1 - S0) * exp(-n / tau); n counts food workdays, not calendar days

soilDynamics.status: scenario-dependent exploratory choice; not yet accepted as a season timing rule
soilDynamics.shortRainCaveat: 6-8 day rainy spells can have lower realized harvest than steady-state rain potential

calibration.targetInterpretation: reference scenario diagnostics, not jobs quotas, hard gameplay gates, or guarantees for random world seeds

reproducibility.sampleMapAccess: farm tile within +/-9 cells X/Y of at least one initial household; excludes later migrations and dynamically farmed land
